ModMetaData.name: RB Apparels
ModMetaData.author: bukog
ModMetaData.description:
DESCRIPTION: This mod adds some SizedApparel-compatible apparel for NL's realistic body. Outfits are modular and categorized into sets Note: I haven't started version 1.7 but apparently it should be compatible with most mods so I included it in supported versions. Personally, I'm going to wait until official release.
HARD REQUIREMENTS: Nal's Realistic Body URL: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820615654
SOFT REQUIREMENTS: SizedApparel-Realistic body -> Adds Sized Apparel mechanics to Realistic Bodies. Compatible and HIGHLY RECOMMENDED with this mod. URL: https://gitgud.io/Talos/sizedapparel-realistic-body
RECOMMENDED: Skimpy Clothes for Nal's Realistic Body -> Adds great clothing for Realistic Body. This mod (RB Apparels) adds swimsuit and shibari textures (as of the moment). URL: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3220388881 SizedApparel-Realistic Body-More Apparels -> Adds Sized Apparel Bunnysuits from Skimpy Clothes URL: https://gitgud.io/Alxgry/sized-apparel-realistic-body-more-apparels THIGAPPE -> Autofitting for other clothes, generally not SA compatible but looks good URL: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2839518933 Layered Apparel -> allows you to use specific outfits as cosmetics and even combines those that aren't usually equippable together URL: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3632480044
Changelog v1.0 - Added thin textures for ALL currently released apparel - Added New Crafting Workbench (to prevent clutter in default tailoring bench) - Added Apparel Effects (Stat Offsets) - Added New Type of Clothing Sets: > (Bikini) Armor > Military Set > (Colorable) Reverse Outfit > Shiny Bikini - color version of gold bikini - Added New Accessories: > Cow Ears and Tail > Bell Collar > Colored Bunny Ears - Changed Textures: > Nun Set - also now with colors > Golden Bikini > Collar and Tie > Collar and Ribbon - Changed Item Name Formats - Changed Crafting Recipes and Cost to balance for stat effects - Changed Base Stats - Completed Descriptions - Optimized and rewrote XML
